beats.cap: On October 15th, at a SpaceX test site in Texas, a white two-seater drove up a curved ramp, flipped upside down, and landed on its wheels.
beats.say: On October fifteenth, at a SpaceX test site in Texas, a white two-seater drove up a curved ramp, flipped upside down, and landed on its wheels.

beats.cap: Minutes later, the same car ran 0 to 60 in 0.81 seconds.
beats.say: Minutes later, the same car ran zero to sixty in zero point eight one seconds.

beats.cap: This is the new Tesla Roadster. Nine years late, half the range it promised, and packed with hardware no car has carried before. Let's take it apart.
Tesla first showed this car in November 2017. The promise: 0 to 60 in 1.9 seconds, 620 miles of range, and deliveries in 2020.
beats.say: Tesla first showed this car in November twenty seventeen. The promise: zero to sixty in one point nine seconds, six hundred and twenty miles of range, and deliveries in twenty twenty.

beats.cap: Then the dates slipped. 2022. 2023. 2024. 2025. An April 2026 unveil came and went. Even the October 1st launch was rained out.
beats.say: Then the dates slipped. Twenty twenty two. Twenty twenty three. Twenty twenty four. Twenty twenty five. An April twenty twenty six unveil came and went. Even the October first launch was rained out.

beats.cap: The car that finally showed up is a different machine. Two seats instead of four. Rear-wheel drive instead of three motors. And about 300 miles of range, roughly half the original claim.
beats.say: The car that finally showed up is a different machine. Two seats instead of four. Rear wheel drive instead of three motors. And about three hundred miles of range, roughly half the original claim.

beats.cap: Tesla traded range for weight. The target curb weight is under 1,700 kilograms, light for a car with this much power.
beats.say: Tesla traded range for weight. The target curb weight is under seventeen hundred kilograms, light for a car with this much power.

beats.cap: Start with the drivetrain. Two rear motors, one per wheel, together making more than one megawatt. That's 1,341 horsepower.
beats.say: Start with the drivetrain. Two rear motors, one per wheel, together making more than one megawatt. That's thirteen hundred and forty one horsepower.

beats.cap: Each motor drives its wheel through its own 8.4 to 1 planetary gearset and its own inverter. There's no differential. Software splits torque between the rear wheels to push the car through corners.
beats.say: Each motor drives its wheel through its own eight point four to one planetary gearset and its own inverter. There's no differential. Software splits torque between the rear wheels to push the car through corners.

beats.cap: The battery uses Tesla's 4680 cells in a pack running at 800 to 1,000 volts. Tesla hasn't given the capacity, only well over 100 kilowatt-hours.
beats.say: The battery uses Tesla's forty-six eighty cells in a pack running at eight hundred to one thousand volts. Tesla hasn't given the capacity, only well over one hundred kilowatt hours.

beats.cap: That voltage pays off at the charger: up to 500 kilowatts on a V4 Supercharger, roughly ten minutes from 15 to 80 percent. On the way out, the pack can deliver a full megawatt.
beats.say: That voltage pays off at the charger: up to five hundred kilowatts on a V4 Supercharger, roughly ten minutes from fifteen to eighty percent. On the way out, the pack can deliver a full megawatt.

beats.cap: But power is useless if the tires can't put it down. That's where the Roadster gets clever.
At the back are four fans, each about 20 kilowatts. Skirts drop down to seal the underbody, and the fans pull a vacuum beneath the car, sucking it onto the road.
beats.say: At the back are four fans, each about twenty kilowatts. Skirts drop down to seal the underbody, and the fans pull a vacuum beneath the car, sucking it onto the road.

beats.cap: Because suction doesn't need speed, it works from a standstill. Tesla claims more than two g of cornering grip, even at walking pace, where wings make no downforce at all.
Above 200 miles an hour the skirts open and the fans switch roles. Add a rear wing that tilts 90 degrees into an air brake, and the car reshapes its own aerodynamics on the fly.
beats.say: Above two hundred miles an hour the skirts open and the fans switch roles. Add a rear wing that tilts ninety degrees into an air brake, and the car reshapes its own aerodynamics on the fly.

beats.cap: If you're enjoying this breakdown, hit like and subscribe. It really helps the channel.
Now for the part that sounds like science fiction. The Thrust and Rocket trims carry rocket thrusters.
They're cold-gas thrusters, co-developed with SpaceX. Nitrogen is stored in carbon-overwrapped pressure vessels rated to 10,000 psi, the same type of tank SpaceX flies on its rockets.
beats.say: They're cold gas thrusters, co-developed with SpaceX. Nitrogen is stored in carbon overwrapped pressure vessels rated to ten thousand psi, the same type of tank SpaceX flies on its rockets.

beats.cap: Open a valve, and the gas blasts out through nozzles. No combustion, no flame. Tesla says the system peaks above 80 kilonewtons, four to five times the force the tires can transmit.
beats.say: Open a valve, and the gas blasts out through nozzles. No combustion, no flame. Tesla says the system peaks above eighty kilonewtons, four to five times the force the tires can transmit.

v.sub: About 5 s of push per fill

beats.cap: The Thrust trim has four rear nozzles and a 200-liter tank. It's one launch per fill: about five seconds of push.
beats.say: The Thrust trim has four rear nozzles and a two hundred liter tank. It's one launch per fill: about five seconds of push.

beats.cap: The single-seat Rocket adds six more: one pointing down behind each wheel, and two at the nose. That's what lifted the car over a row of Teslas at the unveil.
There's a catch. Refilling the tank takes hours, not minutes. Tesla says it's working toward thirty.
So do the numbers hold up? 0 to 60 in 0.81 seconds means an average of 3.4 g.
beats.say: So do the numbers hold up? Zero to sixty in zero point eight one seconds means an average of three point four g.

beats.cap: Tires and suction give roughly one and a half to two g. The thrusters only need to add the rest, about 25 to 35 kilonewtons for under a second. Well inside the claimed 80. Verdict: plausible.
beats.say: Tires and suction give roughly one and a half to two g. The thrusters only need to add the rest, about twenty five to thirty five kilonewtons for under a second. Well inside the claimed eighty. Verdict: plausible.

lines: 200 L of N₂ at 690 bar ≈ 90 kg

beats.cap: What about flying? By our estimate, a 200-liter tank holds about 90 kilograms of nitrogen, good for about 62 kilonewton-seconds of total push. That's one launch, just as Tesla says.
beats.say: What about flying? By our estimate, a two hundred liter tank holds about ninety kilograms of nitrogen, good for about sixty two kilonewton seconds of total push. That's one launch, just as Tesla says.

beats.cap: The Rocket's 600 liters could, at best, hover the car for about nine seconds. Enough for a jump and a flip. Not enough for a commute. Hops, yes. Flying car, no.
beats.say: The Rocket's six hundred liters could, at best, hover the car for about nine seconds. Enough for a jump and a flip. Not enough for a commute. Hops, yes. Flying car, no.

beats.cap: There are three trims. Performance, the road car, with a $50,000 reservation. Thrust, the track car, at $250,000. And Rocket: invite-only, and not approved for public roads.
beats.say: There are three trims. Performance, the road car, with a fifty thousand dollar reservation. Thrust, the track car, at two hundred fifty thousand. And Rocket: invite only, and not approved for public roads.

beats.cap: What's missing is the price. Tesla hasn't announced one. Production is planned in Texas for 2028, with a larger prototype build early next year.
beats.say: What's missing is the price. Tesla hasn't announced one. Production is planned in Texas for twenty twenty eight, with a larger prototype build early next year.

beats.cap: And there are open questions. Can you legally fire thrusters on a public road? How do regulators treat a 10,000 psi tank in a crash? Musk himself said safety is not the main goal.
beats.say: And there are open questions. Can you legally fire thrusters on a public road? How do regulators treat a ten thousand psi tank in a crash? Musk himself said safety is not the main goal.

beats.cap: So what is the Tesla Roadster? A one-megawatt, fan-assisted, rear-drive two-seater, with an optional can of compressed nitrogen that bends the rules of grip.
beats.say: So what is the Tesla Roadster? A one megawatt, fan assisted, rear drive two seater, with an optional can of compressed nitrogen that bends the rules of grip.

beats.cap: The engineering is real, and the physics checks out. The question is the one Tesla has faced since 2017: when can you actually buy one?
beats.say: The engineering is real, and the physics checks out. The question is the one Tesla has faced since twenty seventeen: when can you actually buy one?
